scope: Strict OpenAPI and runtime response contracts for five private, location-scoped saved-trend GET endpoints.

routes.constraints: Strict schema-aligned fields, timezone-aware timestamps, finite numbers, bounded item count, and request-bound location/limit/offset.
Schema-backed smoothing method, bounded list, finite values, timezone-aware timestamps, and request-bound location/metric/limit.
Schema-backed detection method, direction and status, finite values, bounded list, and request-bound location/metric/limit.
Schema-backed decomposition method, component arrays capped at 200, finite values, truncation counts, and request-bound location/metric.
Schema-backed model/status, forecast and interval arrays capped at 100, finite values, and request-bound location/metric.

privacy_and_errors.unselected_database_metadata: Not selected by current read queries and rejected by nested extra-forbid models.
privacy_and_errors.malformed_projection: Sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie.
privacy_and_errors.existing_authorization_database_and_inpu: Preserved by keeping response validation after their existing handlers.

checks.coverage: Existing signed-tenant/read-scope regressions plus valid and malformed projections for all five GET endpoints and OpenAPI success schemas.

limitations: This closes source/API response contracts only; live OIDC, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate acceptance gates.
